# Linter tool matrix (research, Nov 5 2026; updated Nov 6 fact-check)

Source: subagent research against official docs (links at bottom) + Nov 6 Context7 and scratch verification (`factcheck-2026-11-06.md`). Sizes are approximate. Timings are single-file, warm cache.

## The structural finding

Ten of the tools ship as **PyPI binary wheels**, so `uv tool install <pkg>` (uv itself is a ~15 MB single binary) installs them with no language toolchain:
`ruff`, `yamllint`, `taplo` (x86_64/macOS/Windows; no aarch64 Linux wheel → GitHub release binary on ARM), `rumdl`, `gdtoolkit`, `shfmt-py`, `shellcheck-py` (no aarch64 Linux wheel → GitHub release binary on ARM), `clang-format`, `clang-tidy`, `hadolint-py`. (Note: `stylua` is **not** on PyPI — 404; install from GitHub Releases.)
PyPI wheel tier total: **~85 MB download / ~265 MB installed** (`clang-tidy` is ~40 MB wheel / ~148 MB unpacked; `hadolint-py` 12–20 MB wheel / 53 MB installed; `rumdl` ~8 MB wheel / 19 MB installed).

Only four packs genuinely need their own SDK: **Rust** (~900 MB), **Go** (~350 MB), **.NET/C#** (~450 MB), **PowerShell** (~200 MB) — plus **Node** only if `tsc` is wanted (`biome` and `oxlint` are standalone binaries). All installs are strictly **user-space (no sudo / no root package managers)**: official tarballs/zips into `~/.local/opt/adopt-place`, `~/.rustup`, `~/.cargo`, and PowerShell `CurrentUser` modules.

## 1. General & systems languages

| Language | Detect | PRE (sub-second) | POST (on demand) | User-space install (Linux / macOS / Windows), wheel? | Size | Offline | Official image |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Python | `pyproject.toml`, `requirements.txt`, `*.py` | `ruff check --select E9,F63,F7,F82 --output-format json F && ruff format --check F` (~10 ms) | `ruff check --output-format json DIR` + optional `ty check`/`pyright` | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install ruff` (or pinned in `plugin.yaml`) | ~12–15 MB | yes | `ghcr.io/astral-sh/ruff`, `python:3-slim` |
| Rust | `Cargo.toml` | `rustfmt --check --edition <from Cargo.toml> F` (~15 ms, no Cargo graph) or `cargo fmt --check` | `cargo clippy --all-targets --offline --message-format=json -- -D warnings` (1–10 s+) | no wheel: `rustup-init -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy` (`static.rust-lang.org`) | rustfmt ~6 MB; toolchain+clippy ~0.8–1.2 GB | rustfmt yes; clippy needs `--offline` + cached deps | `rust:1-slim` |
| JS / TS | `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `biome.json` | `biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false --reporter json F` (~10–25 ms; or `biome format`) | `biome ci --reporter json .` or `oxlint --deny-warnings --format json .` (~50–200 ms) + `tsc --noEmit` (2–15 s) | no wheel; standalone binaries from official GitHub Releases (`biomejs/biome`, `oxc-project/oxc`) | biome 2.6 ~83–109 MB; oxlint ~18 MB (biome+oxlint ~100–124 MB) | yes (biome/oxlint need no node_modules; note plugins/jsPlugins/TS config execute repo code) | `ghcr.io/biomejs/biome`, `node:lts-slim` |
| Go | `go.mod` | `gofmt -e -l F` (~5–15 ms) | `go vet ./...` (1–3 s) or `golangci-lint run --output.json.path stdout ./...` (2–10 s; executes repo code with cgo) | no wheel: official `go.dev/dl/` tar.gz/zip unpacked to user-space + `golangci-lint` release tar.gz/zip | gofmt ~15 MB (SDK 200–450 MB); golangci-lint ~35 MB | yes once module cache exists | `golang:1-alpine`, `golangci/golangci-lint` |
| C / C++ (incl. Unreal) | `CMakeLists.txt`, `compile_commands.json`, `*.uproject`, `.clang-format` | `clang-format --dry-run -Werror F` (~10–20 ms; fine with `UCLASS()` macros if `.clang-format` present) | `clang-tidy -p <compile_db_dir> F` (requires `compile_commands.json` in `.`, `build/`, or `out/` — without it `clang-tidy` prints "Running without flags" and exits 0, so skip when absent) | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install clang-format` / `clang-tidy` (or pinned in `plugin.yaml`) | clang-format wheel ~2.5 MB; clang-tidy ~40 MB wheel / **148 MB unpacked** | yes | `silkeh/clang` (community) |

## 2. Game-studio languages

| Language | Detect | PRE | POST | User-space install, wheel? | Size | Offline | Official image |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C# (Unity / Godot) | `*.csproj`, `*.sln`, `ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt`, `project.godot` | `csharpier check F` (needs csharpier ≥1.0; pinned 1.3.0; ~50–100 ms) | `dotnet format --verify-no-changes --no-restore` (cwd solution/project, or `--include F` per file; runs Roslyn analyzers/generators → executes repo code) | no wheel: .NET 8 SDK tarball/zip from `builds.dotnet.microsoft.com` (`dotnet-install.sh --install-dir` style user-space unpack); `csharpier` ships as NuGet `.nupkg` only (no AOT binary on releases) → `dotnet tool install csharpier --version 1.3.0 --tool-path <bin_dir>` | csharpier nupkg tool ~25 MB; SDK 200–500 MB | yes (`--no-restore`) | `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:8.0` |
| GDScript (Godot) | `project.godot`, `*.gd` | `gdformat --check F` (~80–150 ms, full AST) | `gdlint F` (~100–250 ms) | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install "gdtoolkit==4.*"` (`3.*` for Godot 3) | ~5–8 MB | yes | none official (`barichello/godot-ci` community) |
| Lua / Luau (Love2D, Defold, Roblox) | `*.rockspec`, `conf.lua`, `game.project`, `default.project.json`, `selene.toml` | `stylua --check F` (~5–15 ms; `--output-format=json` available; Lua 5.1–5.4, LuaJIT, Luau) | `selene --display-style=Json2 F` (or `json`; ~10–50 ms, Roblox std built in ≥0.26) | **no wheel** (stylua is not on PyPI); both on GitHub Releases (`JohnnyMorganz/StyLua`, `Kampfkarren/selene`) | stylua ~6 MB; selene ~8 MB | yes | `johnnymorganz/stylua`; none for selene |
| Shaders (HLSL / GLSL) | GLSL: `*.vert/*.frag/*.comp/*.geom/*.tesc/*.tese/*.glsl` (`*.gdshader` and Unity `*.shader` are **not** GLSL); HLSL: `*.hlsl`, `*.fx`, `*.ush/*.usf` | GLSL: `glslangValidator -V -o <tmp.spv> [-S <stage>] F` (skip `.glsl` with no derivable stage; leave HLSL to dxc — `-D` without `-V`/`-E` always errors); HLSL: `dxc -T lib_6_x -Fo /dev/null F` (avoid hardcoded `-T ps_6_0 -E main`) | GLSL: `glslangValidator -V --spirv-val -o <tmp.spv> [-S <stage>] F` (`--spirv-val` is a no-op without `-V`/`-G`); HLSL: `dxc -Weverything -T lib_6_x -Fo /dev/null F` | no wheel: glslang zip on `KhronosGroup/glslang` releases; dxc tar.gz/zip on `microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler` releases | glslang ~5 MB; dxc ~45 MB zip / ~120 MB extracted | yes | none official |

## 3. Shell, scripting, config

| Language | Detect | PRE | POST | User-space install, wheel? | Size | Offline | Official image |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shell (bash/sh) | `*.sh`, `*.bash`, shebang | `shfmt -d F` (~5–10 ms) | `shellcheck -f json1 F` (or `-f json`; ~15–40 ms) | **wheel yes** (`shfmt-py`, `shellcheck-py` on x86_64/macOS/Windows; on `aarch64` Linux `shellcheck-py` has sdist only → install `koalaman/shellcheck` release `.tar.xz`) | shfmt ~4 MB; shellcheck ~8–15 MB | yes | `koalaman/shellcheck:stable`, `mvdan/shfmt` |
| PowerShell | `*.ps1`, `*.psm1`, `*.psd1` | `pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($env:TARGET,[ref]$null,[ref]$e); if($e){$e \| ConvertTo-Json; exit 1}"` (~80 ms) | `pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $env:TARGET -Recurse \| ConvertTo-Json"` (default table output truncates; pass path via env var or escaped single-quoted literal to prevent quote injection) | no wheel: official `PowerShell/PowerShell` tar.gz/zip unpacked to user-space; then `pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -RequiredVersion 1.25.0 -Scope CurrentUser -Force"` | pwsh 150–250 MB; module ~5 MB | yes once module installed | `mcr.microsoft.com/powershell` |
| JSON / JSONC | `*.json`, `*.jsonc` | `biome check --formatter-enabled=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false --reporter json F` (or `biome format F`, ~10 ms, JSONC ok) | `biome ci --reporter json .` | biome standalone binary | ~83–109 MB (shared with JS/TS) | yes | `ghcr.io/biomejs/biome` |
| YAML | `*.yml`, `*.yaml` | `yamllint -f parsable -d "{extends: relaxed, rules: {line-length: disable}}" F` (~40 ms) | `yamllint -f parsable --strict F` | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install yamllint` | ~2 MB | yes | `cytopia/yamllint` (community) |
| TOML | `*.toml` | `taplo format --check F` (~5–10 ms) | `taplo lint --no-schema F` (`--no-schema` = guaranteed no network) | **wheel yes** on x86_64/macOS/Windows (`taplo==0.9.3`); no `aarch64` Linux wheel (sdist needs cargo+maturin) → `tamasfe/taplo` GitHub release `.gz` binary on ARM | ~4.5 MB | yes with `--no-schema` | `tamasfe/taplo` |
| Markdown | `*.md` | `rumdl check --output-format json .` (~5–15 ms) | `rumdl check --output-format json DIR` | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install rumdl` | ~8 MB wheel / **19 MB installed** | yes | `davidanson/markdownlint-cli2` |
| Dockerfile | `Dockerfile*`, `Containerfile` | `hadolint -f json F` (~10–25 ms; default `--failure-threshold` is `info`) | `hadolint -f json --failure-threshold warning F` (includes embedded-shell ShellCheck; note `--failure-threshold warning` is *less* strict on exit code than the default `info` threshold) | **wheel yes**: `uv tool install hadolint-py` | 12–20 MB wheel / **53 MB installed** | yes | `hadolint/hadolint`, `ghcr.io/hadolint/hadolint` |

## Tier summary (user-space, no sudo)

| Tier | Tools | Size | Install method (no Docker, no root package managers) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **PyPI wheels** (`plugin.yaml` `python_dependencies`) | ruff, yamllint, taplo (non-ARM), rumdl, shfmt-py, shellcheck-py (non-ARM), hadolint-py, clang-format, clang-tidy, gdtoolkit | ~85 MB download / **~265 MB installed** | Installed automatically by Hermes with the plugin; PEP 508 markers exclude `taplo` and `shellcheck-py` on `aarch64`/`ARM64` |
| **Standalone binaries** (`setup_manifest.py` / `lint_setup.py`) | biome (~83–109 MB), oxlint (~18 MB), golangci-lint (~35 MB), stylua (~6 MB), selene (~8 MB), glslangValidator (~5 MB), dxc (~45 MB zip / ~120 MB extracted), plus taplo & shellcheck on ARM | **~180–235 MB** download | Official GitHub release tarballs/zips/gz verified by SHA-256 into `~/.local/opt/adopt-place/` |
| **Language SDKs** (`setup_manifest.py`) | Rust (`rustup-init` minimal + `rustfmt,clippy`, ~900 MB), Go (`go.dev` tarball/zip, ~350 MB), .NET 8 SDK (`builds.dotnet.microsoft.com` tarball/zip + `dotnet tool install csharpier --version 1.3.0 --tool-path`, ~450 MB), PowerShell (`PowerShell` release tar.gz/zip + `Install-Module PSScriptAnalyzer -Scope CurrentUser`, ~200 MB) | **~1.9 GB** | Official archives/installers unpacked in user-space (`~/.local/opt/adopt-place`, `~/.rustup`, `~/.cargo`); skipped when already on `PATH` |

Notes for the plugin:
- **Structured output flags to prefer**: ruff/rumdl `--output-format json`, yamllint `-f parsable`, shellcheck `-f json1` (or `-f json`), hadolint `-f json`, stylua `--output-format=json`, selene `--display-style=Json2` (or `json`), clippy `--message-format=json`, biome `--reporter json`, oxlint `--format json`, golangci-lint `--output.json.path stdout`, PSScriptAnalyzer `| ConvertTo-Json`.
- PRE must never need network. Every PRE command above is offline. `taplo lint` needs `--no-schema`; `cargo clippy` needs `--offline`.
- Unreal/CMake C++ POST (`clang-tidy`) requires `compile_commands.json` (searched in `.`, `build/`, `out/`); without one `clang-tidy` prints `"Running without flags"` and exits 0, so the runner reports it skipped/`not_configured`.
